notes.general_comments:
This paper was taken by 6304 candidates. The mean score was 17.7 with a standard deviation of 6.7.
The intended facility of the items was 0.25 to 0.80. No items proved to be too difficult. However one item
proved to be too easy. This was item 15.
There was one item where discrimination was below the design limit of 0.25. This was item 2.
Areas of weakness in candidates’ understanding were in bank reconciliation statements and overhead
absorption.
